title: Steel Furnace
description: The &3Steel Furnace&r, unlike the other furnaces, runs off of &eTU&r. It can also process up to 3 items at a time, but each slot consumes more TU, which makes it slow without a strong heat source. It also has a bonus output for ores and wood, where every smelted item gives &e25%&r to the bonus output meter, which means every 4 items give an extra 5th item for free (&e+15 items from a single stack&r).
